html:
Built a Grok Bot contest template for allergy-aware grocery scoring.

Paste a basket + allergen profile. It pulls Open Food Facts tags, then Jev Scores each line: clear, caution_traces, conflict, or unknown_data.

Traces never get a free pass as clear. Thin data lands… https://t.co/bPwu9tRiz2
